Bloodfang Bite 572551 (single-target direct melee, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 8388608, CasterAuraSpell 525031) spell_taken_crit_chance (Unit.cpp:10659, 4404-4405) read before (dummy 99%, unlearned) and after learning 680675 (dummy 76%, just above 75%): +20.0 points (Felsworn 802180 precedent).
